name: Fushiga
subcategory: Satirical genre of ukiyo-e woodblock prints
summary: Fushiga (Japanese: 風刺画, lit. 'satirical caricature') is a genre of ukiyo-e woodblock prints depicting satirical pictures accompanied by text.
description: Fushiga (Japanese: 風刺画, lit. 'satirical caricature') is a genre of ukiyo-e woodblock prints depicting satirical pictures accompanied by text. Fushiga prints usually depicted ordinary people in their everyday activities, with their exclamations written next to them, and not celebrities or famous landscapes. Fushiga relied more on text than on the image, and because of that was "virtually ignored by Western critics of the print".
